next_milestone.title: Durable tool-effect crash recovery across existing producers
next_milestone.first_slice: Inventory actual work dispatch producers and retain their intent/lease/budget/receipt ownership. Extend the existing local-tool lost-ack path to a controller-admitted transport effect using a local controlled service, after PR13 integration is reviewed. Do not replace the scheduler or database.
acceptance: Crash before durable intent: zero external attempts.
Crash after intent but before dispatch: current fence can reconcile without duplicate authority.
Crash after effect and before acknowledgement: one attempt; retained target/receipt evidence resolves or remains indeterminate, never blind retry.
Crash after receipt but before settlement: reconcile the same receipt exactly once; budget/concurrency never released twice.
Duplicate delivery, expired owner, changed task/repository/policy, pause/cancel and restart reject stale writes.
Real PostgreSQL transactions, restricted roles, durable event/cursor and artifact identities are checked; fixture transport does not qualify production egress.
